question: Identify the L1_model associated with each model (specified by name and version) that occurs most frequently for each status ('strong' or 'soft'), along with the number of times it occurs. A model has a 'strong' status if, for any of its steps, the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models is less than the 'Stack' model's test score. It has a 'soft' status if the maximum test score among non-'Stack' models equals the 'Stack' model's test score. Count how many times each L1_model is associated with a 'strong' or 'soft' status across all models, and determine which L1_model has the highest occurrence for each status.
sql:
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        step,
        MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_per_step AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.name,
        ss.version,
        ss.step,
        ss.test_score as stack_score,
        nsm.max_non_stack_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score < ss.test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score = ss.test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END as step_status
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN non_stack_max nsm ON ss.name = nsm.name AND ss.version = nsm.version AND ss.step = nsm.step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT 
        status_per_step.name,
        status_per_step.version,
        m.L1_model,
        status_per_step.step_status
    FROM status_per_step
    JOIN model m ON status_per_step.name = m.name AND status_per_step.version = m.version AND status_per_step.step = m.step
    WHERE status_per_step.step_status IS NOT NULL
),
l1_model_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        L1_model,
        step_status,
        COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
    FROM model_status
    GROUP BY L1_model, step_status
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        L1_model,
        step_status,
        occurrence_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step_status ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC) as rn
    FROM l1_model_counts
)
SELECT 
    L1_model,
    step_status,
    occurrence_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY step_status, L1_model

WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        step,
        MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_per_step AS (
    SELECT 
        s.name,
        s.version,
        s.step,
        ss.test_score as stack_score,
        nsm.max_non_stack_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score < ss.test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score = ss.test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END as step_status
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN non_stack_max nsm ON s.name = nsm.name AND s.version = nsm.version AND s.step = nsm.step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        L1_model,
        step_status
    FROM status_per_step
    WHERE step_status IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    L1_model,
    step_status
FROM model_status
GROUP BY L1_model, step_status
ORDER BY step_status, L1_model

    SELECT name, version, step, test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        step,
        MAX(test_score) as max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_per_step AS (
    SELECT 
        ss.name,
        ss.version,
        ss.step,
        ss.test_score as stack_score,
        nsm.max_non_stack_score,
        CASE 
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score < ss.test_score THEN 'strong'
            WHEN nsm.max_non_stack_score = ss.test_score THEN 'soft'
            ELSE NULL
        END as step_status
    FROM stack_scores ss
    JOIN non_stack_max nsm ON ss.name = nsm.name AND ss.version = nsm.version AND ss.step = nsm.step
),
model_status AS (
    SELECT 
        name,
        version,
        L1_model,
        step_status
    FROM status_per_step
    WHERE step_status IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    L1_model,
    step_status,
    COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
FROM model_status
GROUP BY L1_model, step_status
ORDER BY step_status, L1_model, occurrence_count DESC
